d: The Trail Blazers defeated the Thunder, 118-108 tonight in Portland. Deni Avdija contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 6 assists 4 steals and 4 three pointers, with Jrue Holiday of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 19 points (5-12 FG, 5-8 3P) in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 31 points along with 4 rebounds for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 8-3 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 8-4 for the season.
